description: Every bump goes through the Dockerfile's test stage (build.yml) before it can merge.

versions.env pins are bumped by the regex manager below; their digests are not, so check-pins.py runs as a post-upgrade task where the Renovate instance allows it, and CI fails on a stale digest otherwise.

customManagers.description: versions.env: a `# renovate: datasource=... depName=... [extractVersion=...] [versioning=...]` comment directly above the version line.

packageRules.description: Node follows the 24 LTS line (NODE_MAJOR in the spec); REA supports 22.19+, 24.11+, 26+.
REA_VERSION in versions.env and deps/rea/package.json + lockfile move together; the build refuses a mismatch.
Ghidra, ghidra-mcp and REA interlock (REA accepts one Ghidra minor line; ghidra-mcp targets one Ghidra release): never automerge, review with the e2e results.
